source.text_it: Con ITS (Intelligent Transport Systems) s'intende "l'integrazione della telematica con l'ingegneria dei trasporti, per la pianificazione, progettazione, esercizio, manutenzione e gestione dei sistemi di trasporto

records.localized_text: 智能交通系统（ITS）是将信息通信技术与交通工程结合，用于交通系统的规划、设计、运营、维护和管理。

source.text_it: Gli ITS (Intelligent Transport Systems) contribuiscono a migliorare la sicurezza della guida e all'incolumità delle persone

records.localized_text: 智能交通系统（ITS）有助于提高驾驶安全和人员安全。

source.text_it: Gli ITS (Intelligent Transport Systems) contribuiscono a migliorare la sicurezza e protezione dei veicoli e delle merci

records.localized_text: 智能交通系统（ITS）有助于提高车辆和货物的安全与保护水平。

source.text_it: Gli ITS (Intelligent Transport Systems) non sono rilevanti nell'ambito della efficienza dei sistemi di trasporto per i passeggeri e le merci

records.localized_text: 智能交通系统（ITS）与客货运输系统效率无关。

source.text_it: I sistemi telematici per i trasporti possono permettere al gestore di flotte di conoscere la situazione dei veicoli o mezzi, determinare le rotte più efficienti

records.localized_text: 交通远程信息系统可以让车队管理人员了解车辆状态并确定最高效的路线。

source.text_it: I sistemi telematici per i trasporti possono permettere al conducente di scegliere e utilizzare le varie opportunità di viaggio secondo i suoi desideri e le sue passioni

records.localized_text: 交通远程信息系统可以让驾驶人根据自己的愿望和爱好选择并使用各种出行机会。

source.text_it: Gli ADAS (sistemi avanzati di assistenza alla guida) sono sistemi che tendono a modificare le scelte di guida (comportamento al volante) in funzione del contesto che influenza la marcia del veicolo

records.localized_text: 高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）倾向于根据影响车辆行驶的环境改变驾驶选择或驾驶行为。

source.text_it: Gli ATMS (Advanced Traffic Management Systems) sono sistemi che, ad esempio, agiscono attraverso il controllo semaforico delle intersezioni e delle regole di deflusso/circolazione

records.localized_text: 先进交通管理系统（ATMS）例如通过交叉口信号控制和交通流规则发挥作用。

source.text_it: Gli ATIS (Advanced Traveller Information Systems) hanno come carattere distintivo quello di influenzare le scelte di viaggio come, ad esempio, le scelte di percorso

records.localized_text: 先进出行者信息系统（ATIS）的特点是影响出行选择，例如路线选择。

source.text_it: L'ATDM (sistemi avanzati di controllo della domanda di mobilità) sono sistemi che tendono a modificare le scelte di guida (comportamento al volante) in funzione del contesto che influenza la marcia del veicolo

records.localized_text: 先进出行需求管理系统（ATDM）倾向于根据影响车辆行驶的环境改变驾驶行为。

source.text_it: Gli ADAS (sistemi avanzati di assistenza alla guida) sono sistemi che influenzano le scelte di viaggio come, ad esempio, le scelte di percorso

records.localized_text: 高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）影响出行选择，例如路线选择。

source.text_it: Per risolvere i maggiori problemi dei sistemi di trasporto le teorie economiche suggeriscono l'abbandono di approcci "by-pricing" (attraverso la tariffazione) e "by-quantity" (attraverso la limitazione diretta all'utilizzo)

records.localized_text: 为解决交通系统的主要问题，经济理论建议放弃定价和直接限制使用数量的方法。

source.text_it: In un contesto ITS i "permessi commerciabili di guida" sono intesi come permessi acquisibili dai viaggiatori in cambio di comportamenti "virtuosi"

records.localized_text: 在智能交通系统中，“可交易驾驶许可”是出行者通过良好行为获得的许可。

source.text_it: Ai fini di un trasporto multimodale ed intermodale di merci senza ostruzioni non è importante la conoscenza, da parte degli operatori, della posizione della merce e di orari, traffico, spazi disponibili

records.localized_text: 为实现畅通的多式联运和联运货物运输，运营者无需了解货物位置、时刻、交通状况和可用空间。

source.text_it: Ai fini di un trasporto multimodale ed intermodale di merci senza ostruzioni è importante l'automazione nella movimentazione delle merci, per quanto possibile

records.localized_text: 为实现畅通的多式联运和联运货物运输，尽可能实现货物搬运自动化很重要。

source.text_it: Ai fini di un trasporto multimodale ed intermodale di merci senza ostruzioni è importante il servizio di monitoraggio remoto soprattutto per le materie pericolose

records.localized_text: 为实现畅通的多式联运和联运货物运输，远程监控服务很重要，尤其对危险品而言。

source.text_it: I sistemi di localizzazione automatica servono per conoscere la posizione di una persona, di un veicolo o di una merce durante lo spostamento, nel tentativo di soddisfare uno o più requisiti della mobilità o della logistica

records.localized_text: 自动定位系统用于了解人员、车辆或货物移动时的位置，以满足一项或多项出行或物流要求。

source.text_it: La gestione delle flotte attraverso la localizzazione automatica non rappresenta uno dei requisiti della mobilità del trasporto di merci

records.localized_text: 通过自动定位进行车队管理不是货运出行要求之一。

source.text_it: I sistemi di identificazione automatica (AIS, AVI, AEI) sono finalizzati al riconoscimento inequivocabile di un passeggero o della merce

records.localized_text: 自动识别系统（AIS、AVI、AEI）旨在明确识别乘客或货物。

source.text_it: L'identificazione automatica non rileva informazioni inerenti al conducente, ai viaggiatori e all'unità di trasporto (mono o multimodale)

records.localized_text: 自动识别不采集与驾驶人、乘客及单一或多式运输单元有关的信息。

source.text_it: Uno dei sistemi disponibili per l'identificazione automatica finalizzata al riconoscimento di un passeggero è il codice a barre lineare e bidimensionale

records.localized_text: 线性条形码和二维码是可用于自动识别乘客的系统之一。

source.text_it: L'identificazione automatica può essere finalizzata al riempimento di una unità di carico ma non ai fini di puro controllo e verifica

records.localized_text: 自动识别可以用于装满装载单元，但不能仅用于控制和核验。

source.text_it: L'identificazione automatica può essere finalizzata ad esempio alla necessità di associare della documentazione alla merce in transito

records.localized_text: 自动识别例如可以将文件与运输中的货物关联。

source.text_it: I rilevamenti dei dati di traffico possono essere effettuati solo tramite strumenti inseriti nella pavimentazione (intrusivi, GD)

records.localized_text: 交通数据只能通过嵌入路面的侵入式设备（GD）采集。

source.text_it: Tra i principali strumenti o tecnologie disponibili per i rilevamenti dei dati di traffico possiamo annoverare le spire induttive, microonde, infrarossi e ultrasuoni

records.localized_text: 主要交通数据采集技术包括感应线圈、微波、红外和超声波。

rows.text: 智能交通系统将信息和通信技术用于运输管理，连接数据、车辆和基础设施，以支持运输系统的各项活动。
evidence: https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road_en — European Commission, Road: intelligent transport uses ICT in road traffic and its interfaces with transport modes, to assist mobility, safety, and efficiency.

rows.text: 智能交通系统可以提示危险并辅助驾驶，有助于预防事故和保护人员。
evidence: European Commission, Smart mobility, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility_en: ITS applies ICT to improve safety and efficiency for passengers and freight.
NHTSA, Driver Assistance Technologies, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/driver-assistance-technologies: collision warning and lane keeping respond to conditions around the vehicle.

rows.text: 位置和货物信息有助于在运输途中跟踪车辆与货物并发现异常。
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: 智能交通系统也有助于提高效率：交通信息和车队管理能帮助更好地安排客运与货运。
evidence: European Commission, Smart mobility, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility_en: ITS applies ICT to improve safety and efficiency for passengers and freight.

European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: 车辆位置和交通信息有助于车队管理者跟踪车辆并规划更高效的路线。
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.
US DOT, ITS ePrimer module 3, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm: FHWA chapter 4 describes traffic monitoring, signal timing and comparative route travel information.

rows.text: 题库判为错误，但“愿望和爱好”表述含糊，并不能排除系统提供个性化选择。例如，交通信息服务可提供交通状况和备选路线，帮助驾驶人评估行程。
evidence: https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road_en — European Commission, Road: ITS and real-time traffic and travel information support mobility and navigation.

https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm — FHWA, chapter 4: traffic centres can show travellers comparative travel times on alternatives so they can assess route, mode or timing. Neither source demonstrates that personal preferences cannot be used; the wording of the printed FALSE is vague.

rows.text: ADAS 根据检测到的情况辅助驾驶：例如警告可能发生的碰撞或帮助车辆保持在车道内。
evidence: NHTSA, Driver Assistance Technologies, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/driver-assistance-technologies: collision warning and lane keeping respond to conditions around the vehicle.

rows.text: ATMS 管理路网交通，例如利用检测数据和控制器根据车流调整信号灯。
evidence: US DOT, ITS ePrimer module 3, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm: FHWA chapter 4 describes traffic monitoring, signal timing and comparative route travel information.
https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/innovation/everydaycounts/edc-1/asct-faqs.cfm — FHWA adaptive signal control FAQ: traffic demand data are used to adjust signal timing.

rows.text: ATIS 向出行者提供交通和行程时间等信息，帮助其选择路线。
evidence: US DOT, ITS ePrimer module 3, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm: FHWA chapter 4 describes traffic monitoring, signal timing and comparative route travel information.

rows.text: 需求管理涉及出行时间、路线或交通方式等选择；行驶中的操作辅助则属于 ADAS 的功能。
evidence: FHWA, Active Transportation and Demand Management guide, section 2, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop13042/sec2.htm: demand management shifts travel times, routes or modes; dynamic pricing responds to congestion.
NHTSA, Driver Assistance Technologies, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/driver-assistance-technologies: collision warning and lane keeping respond to conditions around the vehicle.

rows.text: ADAS 辅助驾驶操作，例如发出碰撞警告；出行者信息系统提供选择路线所需的信息。
evidence: NHTSA, Driver Assistance Technologies, https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/driver-assistance-technologies: collision warning and lane keeping respond to conditions around the vehicle.
US DOT, ITS ePrimer module 3, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/fhwahop14022/chapter4.htm: FHWA chapter 4 describes traffic monitoring, signal timing and comparative route travel information.

rows.text: 收费和数量限制是管理运输需求的可选工具，并非必须放弃的方法。
evidence: FHWA, Road Pricing, https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/roadpricing/: congestion pricing uses charges to affect travel demand; DTU, Transportation Research C 151 (2023) 104121, https://backend.orbit.dtu.dk/ws/portalfiles/portal/319762391/1_s2.0_S0968090X23001109_main.pdf: tradable mobility credits are a quantity-control approach.

rows.text: 在某些方案中，出行者可以因选择可持续出行方式获得并交易积分：这是出行激励，不是驾驶执照。
evidence: University of Sydney, Tradeable mobility and environmental credits, https://www.sydney.edu.au/business/news-and-events/news/2026/10/06/tradeable-mobility-and-environmental-credits-.html: a proposed scheme awards credits for public transport, walking, cycling or shared rides; schemes can allow trading.

rows.text: 了解货物位置、交通、时刻和可用空间有助于协调不同运输方式之间的转运并减少等待。
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: 在枢纽实现货物装卸自动化，可以帮助货物在不同运输方式之间转运，使作业更顺畅。
evidence: European Commission CORDIS, Operational automation to support multimodal freight transport, https://cordis.europa.eu/programme/id/HORIZON_HORIZON-CL5-2023-D6-01-07: automated terminal operations can support seamless multimodal logistics.

rows.text: 远程监测可以提供货物运输途中的位置和状态，对危险货物尤其有用。
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: 自动定位可确定移动物体的位置，例如在物流网络中跟踪车辆或货运。
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: 自动定位有助于货运车队管理：知道车辆的位置有助于跟踪和安排其行程。
evidence: European Commission, Freight and Logistics, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road/application-areas/freight-and-logistics_en: ICT supports fleet management, tracking and the location and condition of freight, especially dangerous goods.

rows.text: 自动识别将可读取的代码与货运单元或旅行凭证关联，使系统能够识别它并连接相关数据。
evidence: GS1, Logistic Label Guideline, https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/logistic-label/1.3.0/, section 9.4.4: scanning logistics labels records unloaded units; GS1, https://support.gs1.org/support/solutions/articles/43000734484-what-is-the-only-compulsory-data-on-the-logistic-label-: unique SSCC links units to electronic business messages.

IATA, Common Use Standards, Resolution 792, https://www.iata.org/en/programs/passenger/common-use/: a two-dimensional barcode carries boarding-pass data; IATA, https://airtechzone.iata.org/aidm_model/21.1/EARoot/EA5/EA3/EA4/EA4/EA10350.htm: barcode information supports passenger authentication and authorization.

rows.text: 自动识别可以将代码与相关数据关联，例如货运单元或旅行凭证的数据；它并不排除这些信息。
evidence: GS1, Logistic Label Guideline, https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/logistic-label/1.3.0/, section 9.4.4: scanning logistics labels records unloaded units; GS1, https://support.gs1.org/support/solutions/articles/43000734484-what-is-the-only-compulsory-data-on-the-logistic-label-: unique SSCC links units to electronic business messages.

IATA, Common Use Standards, Resolution 792, https://www.iata.org/en/programs/passenger/common-use/: a two-dimensional barcode carries boarding-pass data; IATA, https://airtechzone.iata.org/aidm_model/21.1/EARoot/EA5/EA3/EA4/EA4/EA10350.htm: barcode information supports passenger authentication and authorization.

rows.text: 旅行凭证上的条码可以自动读取并关联乘客数据；例如登机牌使用二维条码。
evidence: IATA, Common Use Standards, Resolution 792, https://www.iata.org/en/programs/passenger/common-use/: a two-dimensional barcode carries boarding-pass data; IATA, https://airtechzone.iata.org/aidm_model/21.1/EARoot/EA5/EA3/EA4/EA4/EA10350.htm: barcode information supports passenger authentication and authorization.

rows.text: 自动识别也可用于核对和检查货运单元：扫描可以记录哪些货物已卸下。
evidence: GS1, Logistic Label Guideline, https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/logistic-label/1.3.0/, section 9.4.4: scanning logistics labels records unloaded units; GS1, https://support.gs1.org/support/solutions/articles/43000734484-what-is-the-only-compulsory-data-on-the-logistic-label-: unique SSCC links units to electronic business messages.

rows.text: 读取货物上的识别码可以将实物单元与相关电子信息关联，从而方便关联文件。
evidence: GS1, Logistic Label Guideline, https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/logistic-label/1.3.0/, section 9.4.4: scanning logistics labels records unloaded units; GS1, https://support.gs1.org/support/solutions/articles/43000734484-what-is-the-only-compulsory-data-on-the-logistic-label-: unique SSCC links units to electronic business messages.

rows.text: 并非只能使用埋入路面的传感器：道路上方的微波等设备也能检测交通。
evidence: FHWA, Traffic Detector Handbook, third edition, chapter 1, https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/research/operations/ITS/06108/01.cfm: loops are embedded in pavement; radar, infrared and ultrasonic detectors can be installed above the road.

rows.text: 埋在路面中的感应线圈可检测车辆；微波、红外线和超声波传感器也能收集交通数据。
evidence: FHWA, Traffic Detector Handbook, third edition, chapter 1, https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/research/operations/ITS/06108/01.cfm: loops are embedded in pavement; radar, infrared and ultrasonic detectors can be installed above the road.

review.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_vehicle_review
review.review_evidence: Reviewed all 25 source questions and verdicts, four language explanations and cited evidence; no figures. European Commission road ITS and freight, US FHWA traffic information and management, NHTSA ADAS, DTU tradable-credit quantity control study, University of Sydney October 2026 proposed earned-credit scheme, GS1 logistics labels, IATA boarding passes and FHWA detector handbook directly inspected. 31454 retains FALSO and visibly notes vague source wording without denying personalized choices.

issues.reason: The printed answer is false, but the assertion that transport telematics can let a driver choose travel opportunities according to desires and passions is broad and does not identify a verifiable false technical restriction. The sources support personalized travel choices; no authoritative source resolves why the printed verdict is false.
checked_sources: European Commission, Road, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/transport-themes/smart-mobility/road_en: navigation systems consider real-time traffic and travel information.

European Commission, ITS KPI guidance, https://transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/93ba8375-0ac0-477d-b6a9-9deca6b5b01d_en?filename=Guidance_document-ITS_KPI_for_the_EU.pdf: dynamic travel information is available before and during trips and includes disruption and travel time information.
